identityDescription: Iris: fictional adult woman, 29. Warm, composed elegance; soft features with a knowing look.

agePresentation.target: late-20s adult woman, age-29 facial appearance
agePresentation.reason: Round-1 candidates read substantially older than canon age 29; numeric age is metadata, visual age presentation is a separate validation gate that must also pass
positiveCues: adult woman in her late twenties
agePresentation.note: This constrains presentation DOWNWARD ONLY to the canonical adult age of 29 - never below adult. The pipeline's mandatory child/teenager negatives remain in force and cannot be overridden by any caller.

invariantIdentity.face: soft oval face, gentle cheekbones, arched brows, light freckling across the nose
invariantIdentity.hair: long auburn, natural wave, side part
invariantIdentity.notes: These traits define WHO Iris is. The LoRA learns these and only these.

allowedVariation.hairStyling: loose, half-up, or soft updo - color and length stay canonical
allowedVariation.notes: Variation the LoRA must tolerate without identity drift.

sceneDependent.wardrobe: elegant earth tones are her DEFAULT STYLE, not identity - no single garment baked in
sceneDependent.background: never part of identity - vary across the training set
sceneDependent.lighting: never part of identity - vary across the training set

forbiddenIdentityDrift: hair color change (no blonde/black/red-shift away from auburn)
face shape hardening into angular features
age drift younger than adult presentation

required: at least 2 wider framings (waist-up, full body)
forbidden: one background dominating >30% of the set
one garment dominating >30% of the set
non-SFW content in the training lane
images of or derived from real people
